description:
Connect your Sprout Social data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how your social profiles are growing and which posts are actually landing.

Compare impressions, engagements, engagement rate, follower growth, clicks, and published posts across date ranges. Break results down by network, profile, or post. Turn your social data into clear reports, spot trends, and see what your audience responds to.

defaultPrompt: How did my social profiles perform last week?
Generate a monthly Sprout Social report covering the last 30 days
Show me my top performing social posts for the last 14 days
